criterion_text: nession-tmux builds, tests and documents as a standalone reusable Rust library (including packaged/external-consumer fixture); its dependency graph, code, and test support contain no Nession business crate/DTO or Agent-only initialization.

verifiers.summary: nession-tmux packages and builds for an external consumer, with no Nession crate, DTO or Agent initialization in its graph or source

evidence.value: exact SHA 8461ea4c3a90a33ce7ad1048fd91fccee31dde11: `cargo test -p nession-tmux` passed its in-memory wire, fake-process and real isolated-tmux tests with no Agent initialization
the packaged dependency graph for nession-tmux names no nession-* crate; the manifest/source independence checks ran in the same test binary
README.md and examples/attach_watch.rs are present and the example compiles as part of `cargo test -p nession-tmux`
cargo package produced nession-tmux-0.1.0.crate and a consumer crate outside the workspace, depending on the extracted package, built TmuxCommand + TmuxOps with its own binary and absolute socket
the public API documentation built with RUSTDOCFLAGS=-D warnings, so no intra-doc link points at an Agent-only or private owner
